description: Month-by-month estimated price for one lane and one truck type, to show whether today's price is high or low. Figures are modeled estimates of the all-in price (linehaul plus fuel) for one full truckload of standard freight, in US dollars. They are not quotes.

destination.description: The delivery place: a city and state such as "Chicago, IL", or a 5-digit ZIP. Lower 48 states only. A city alone picks the largest of that name; the result says which place was used.

months.description: How many of the most recent months to return. Default 24. History starts 2003-12.

origin.description: The pickup place: a city and state such as "Chicago, IL", or a 5-digit ZIP. Lower 48 states only. A city alone picks the largest of that name; the result says which place was used.

name: get_lane_rate_history
title: A lane's price history
